authority.runtime_policy: Natural Auto Live observation only: no return replacement, managed invocation, target-memory write, judgement injection or native input injection.
authority.device_scope: Device frames validate current object/resource/lifecycle composition; portable Browser/Pixi equivalence does not claim fixed-device GPU framebuffer identity.
authority.manual_branch_disposition: Rejected manual five-touch diagnostics were deleted and are not evidence. Auto clear status 1 is not reclassified as FC/AP.

rejected_vertical_inversion_tile.observed_shape: radial burst, not the kira star

particle_texture_material_color_blend.ordinary_and_game_clear_rule: Decoded PNG rows remain top-left raster rows. uvFrame 11 selects column 3,row-from-top 2 for both ordinary and game-clear consumers; game-clear must not invert it to row 1.
particle_texture_material_color_blend.particle_color_contract: Shader RGB is sampled-linear RGB multiplied by particle RGB only. Shader alpha is sampled alpha multiplied by particle alpha. The blend state applies alpha exactly once; multiplying particle alpha into shader RGB would square particle alpha and is rejected.
particle_texture_material_color_blend.framebuffer_gate: Actual Browser/WebGL tests must read the composed framebuffer for a non-unit-alpha edge sample; primitive state alone is insufficient.

slide_flash.portable_conclusion: note_long_flash is bound once from the first current after-node ButtonTypesArray, may differ from the head, and keeps that resource while the stable root/flash/tap-keep identities move through later current nodes.

slide_tap_keep.portable_conclusion: GetSlideNoteTapKeepEffect creates effect_TapKeep, parents it to the stable NoteSlide Transform with serialized local transform, plays after first changeCurrentNote, moves with current-node slidingMove, and stops/clears on terminal teardown without recreating the owner per node.

score_above_ss_clip.portable_conclusion: The high-rank UIPanel right edge continues to follow the current score indicator after SS; it is not clamped to the SS marker.

score_ss_highlight_loop.portable_conclusion: Entering SS starts the 3-second 60-FPS looping sibling highlight once. Later score updates in rank 5 do not restart it; device frames retain visible phase changes through 7.5 seconds.

terminal_final_frame_hold.hold_scope: The sampled final FC/AP frame remains on the persistent branch graph from clip stop until natural scene exit; this is not an infinite residency claim.

base_runtime.route_scope: Auto Live clear status 1 confirms only the base controller; it is not used as an FC/AP branch observation.

terminal_final_frame_hold.branch_authority: Serialized FC/AP controllers/clips plus the clear-status callgraph confirm branch selection and final-frame sampling. No Auto status-1 frame is presented as an FC/AP device frame.
